description_en: Retrieves live recording information. You can call this operation to obtain the playback URL after a live stream ends. If the live stream has not ended, the result is empty
description_zh: 调用GetLiveRecord获取直播录制信息。可用于直播结束后获取回放地址，如果直播未结束，结果为空
kebab_example: aliyun imp get-live-record --app-id lq0000cu --live-id AE350000T95F --user-id 340029 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLiveRecord

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the application, which is a 6-character string of lowercase letters and digits. You can obtain this identifier from the console after creating the application.
parameters.description_zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成，由控制台创建后获取。
